narration.text: [whispers] Don't look at the dolls. They're already looking at you. [long pause] [softly] Xochimilco, Mexico City. For about fifty years, one man lived alone on this little island in the canals. [long pause] Don Julián Santana Barrera said a girl had drowned nearby. He hung dolls in the trees, for her. [long pause] Hundreds of them. He pulled them out of the canals, and out of the trash. [long pause] Visitors say the dolls whisper. That their heads turn when a boat goes by. [long pause] Some say the girl was real. Others say he only dreamed her. No record of her has been found. [long pause] In two thousand one, he was found drowned. In the same canal, his family says. [long pause] Now, on the way back. Look at the same dolls. [long pause] [whispers] Don't look up.
